tasks.objective: Measure runtime and verify outcome-blind dynamics health under the candidate parameters, without a shuffled control or any landscape-effect estimate.
Calibrate conservation, non-negativity, equal-state absorption, time-step convergence and paired discretization-resolution SESOI before confirmatory landscape experiments.
Compare resource-total, histogram, accessible-area and boundary-matched clustered versus spatially shuffled landscapes.
Estimate movement, production and interaction effects in the preregistered 2x2 channel design using E0-frozen SESOI values and Holm correction.
Test the locked clustered-minus-shuffled effect across populations, grid resolutions and an independent holdout landscape family.
